name: Create Exam Template with Monitoring Indicators
description: Create a new exam template in the SEB Server web interface with custom monitoring indicators. Navigate to 'Exam Template' under 'Exam Administration' in the left sidebar. Create a new exam template with the name 'Midterm Proctored Exam Template' and description 'Standard template for proctored midterm examinations with monitoring indicators'. After creating the template, add a monitoring indicator: add a 'Last Ping Time' type indicator named 'Connection Quality' with the following thresholds - set the warning (yellow) threshold at 2000 and the danger (red) threshold at 5000. Save the template with the indicator configured. The SEB Server is accessible at http://localhost:8080 with login credentials super-admin / admin.
